# Shopify Admin launch checklist

This theme branch uses tax-inclusive, fixed-price language. Do not publish it before the matching Shopify Admin settings and product prices are ready.

- [ ] Increase large/heavy, lower-unit-price products by 8%
- [ ] Increase lightweight, higher-unit-price products by 5%
- [ ] Review middle products at 6%–7%
- [ ] Enable the intended tax-inclusive pricing configuration
- [ ] Confirm taxable products are marked to charge tax
- [ ] Confirm free U.S. shipping settings
- [ ] Test a California checkout and verify the total does not add tax a second time
- [ ] Assign the current product template to all active products
- [ ] Remove old $800 minimum and conflicting tax/shipping copy
- [ ] Remove accidental recurring-purchase settings
- [ ] Update store title and meta description
- [ ] Update legal company name to GlobiSun Multimedia Corp.
- [ ] Rewrite About and Contact pages
- [ ] Connect and set globisun.art as the primary domain
